podcast.body: Phil Collins' 1981 rock classic, characterized by its sinister slowburn tempo and a distinctive opening drum break. This song served as the foundation for Kane Brown's recent interpolation "I Can Feel It." "Phil Collins' 1981 Rock Classic in the air tonight."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia
Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia

podcast.body: This iconic song features the distinctive sound of the Roland CR-78 drum machine providing the foundational rhythm before the entry of live drums. "It's what we hear in the Phil Collins song in the air tonight before the real drums kick in."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
